titleStmt.title: The German novel collection for the ELTeC

projectDesc.p: This is the German novel collection for the ELTeC, the European Literary Text Collection, produced by the COST Action Distant Reading for European Literary History (CA16204, distant-reading.net).
Collection editor(s): Fotis Jannidis, Leo Konle, Carolin Odebrecht, an algorithm Sources: Textgrid Repository, Deutsches Textarchiv
